> Design-time prose and catalog image generation: plans are free, paid calls need --confirm-paid, and every candidate is scored and recorded.

## How it answers

- **A mistake in the command exits 1, says what was wrong, and writes nothing.**
  - [skgen paint prose.json is refused: an unknown family](scenarios.md#skgen-paint-prosejson-is-refused-an-unknown-family): “error: unknown family paint”
  - [skgen prose ingest prose.json --only gear/nope --text-file candidate.txt --author me is refused: ingest of an unknown entry](scenarios.md#skgen-prose-ingest-prosejson---only-gearnope---text-file-candidatetxt---author-me-is-refused-ingest-of-an-unknown-entry): “error: no entry gear/nope in manifest”
  - [skgen image generate art.json is refused: image generation unconfirmed](scenarios.md#skgen-image-generate-artjson-is-refused-image-generation-unconfirmed): “error: image generation requires --confirm-paid”
  - [skgen image openai-image generate openai.json is refused: an OpenAI image unconfirmed](scenarios.md#skgen-image-openai-image-generate-openaijson-is-refused-an-openai-image-unconfirmed): “error: refusing paid OpenAI call without --confirm-paid”
  - [skgen image openai-image plan openai-bad-job.json is refused: an OpenAI blueprint's bad job](scenarios.md#skgen-image-openai-image-plan-openai-bad-jobjson-is-refused-an-openai-blueprints-bad-job): “error: job must be seamless_material or hero_scene”
  - [skgen prose ingest prose.json --text-file candidate.txt --author me is refused: ingest without --only](scenarios.md#skgen-prose-ingest-prosejson---text-file-candidatetxt---author-me-is-refused-ingest-without---only): “error: ingest requires --only <id> --text-file <path> --author <text>”
  - [skgen prose prompt prose.json --only gear/nope is refused: --only matches no entry](scenarios.md#skgen-prose-prompt-prosejson---only-gearnope-is-refused---only-matches-no-entry): “error: --only gear/nope matched no entries”
- **Help is the usage text on stdout, and it lists every verb.**
  - [asking for help succeeds](scenarios.md#asking-for-help-succeeds)
    ```text
    $ skgen --help
    usage: skgen prose plan <manifest>
           skgen prose generate <manifest> --confirm-paid [--provider pi-ai|fake] [--only <id>] [--format json|text]
           skgen prose prompt <manifest> [--only <id>] [--format json|text]
           skgen prose ingest <manifest> --only <id> --text-file <path> --author <text> [--provider <name>]
           skgen prose score --text <string> --include <a,b> --not <x,y>
           skgen image plan <manifest> [--only <glob>]
           skgen image generate <manifest> --confirm-paid [--only <glob>]
           skgen image batch <manifest> [--confirm-paid] [--only <glob>] [--compose-only]
           skgen image pixellab <PixelLab command...>
           skgen image openai-image <OpenAI Image command...>
    ```

## Commands

| Command | What it does | Scenarios (count) |
|---|---|---|
| `skgen prose plan <manifest>` | Free: lists each entry with its prompt and model. | [1](scenarios.md#skgen-prose-plan-barbarianjson-only-plans-no-paid-call-nothing-written) |
| `skgen prose generate <manifest> --confirm-paid [--provider pi-ai\|fake] [--only <id>] [--format json\|text]` | Paid with --confirm-paid: writes each candidate and its hygiene to run.json; a plan without it. | [4](scenarios.md#generate-of-text-without-backpack-fails-the-hygiene-gate) |
| `skgen prose prompt <manifest> [--only <id>] [--format json\|text]` | Free, no provider: prints the exact system and user prompt generate would send. | [19](scenarios.md#skgen-prose-prompt-prosejson---only-gearnope-is-refused---only-matches-no-entry) |
| `skgen prose ingest <manifest> --only <id> --text-file <path> --author <text> [--provider <name>]` | Free: records hand-written text as an agent-session cell in run.json, same hygiene gate. | [5](scenarios.md#skgen-prose-ingest-prosejson---only-gearnope---text-file-candidatetxt---author-me-is-refused-ingest-of-an-unknown-entry) |
| `skgen prose score --text <string> --include <a,b> --not <x,y>` | Free: checks a text for required facts and leaked vocabulary. | [2](scenarios.md#a-text-missing-facts-and-leaking-vocabulary-fails) |
| `skgen image plan <manifest> [--only <glob>]` | Free: previews provider route and usage for each art-manifest entry. | [2](scenarios.md#skgen-image-plan-artjson-plans-sprite-1-sprite-2-for-free) |
| `skgen image generate <manifest> --confirm-paid [--only <glob>]` | Paid, needs --confirm-paid: generates, converts and ingests each entry. | [1](scenarios.md#skgen-image-generate-artjson-is-refused-image-generation-unconfirmed) |
| `skgen image batch <manifest> [--confirm-paid] [--only <glob>] [--compose-only]` | Plans without --confirm-paid, generates with it; --compose-only composes overlays locally. | 0 |
| `skgen image pixellab <PixelLab command...>` | PixelLab blueprint workflows: plan, plan-ui, audit-entity-art and generate-pilot plan for free. | [4](scenarios.md#skgen-image-pixellab-plan-pixellabjson-plans-a-dry-run-without-a-credential) |
| `skgen image openai-image <OpenAI Image command...>` | OpenAI Image blueprint workflow: plan is free, generate needs --confirm-paid. | [3](scenarios.md#skgen-image-openai-image-generate-openaijson-is-refused-an-openai-image-unconfirmed) |
